name: Immortal Desires
source:
You've moved to the quiet town of Crimson Beech, but a chilling discovery reveals there's more to this sleepy town than meets the eye.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Immortal_Desires,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你已经搬到了安静的Crimson Beech小镇，但一个令人毛骨悚然的发现表明，这个沉睡的小镇并不像你所看到的那样。
